note: Mix recipes for qa/mix-make.mjs (#188 R12, R5', 6728321330). Tracks by qa/corpus.json id only (R9: no file names); windows in seconds of each source track; bar1At: seconds of a known downbeat, set by ear with key M on the conductor page (R13), null until then (mode A then aligns beats and stays report-only). Mode A: the incoming is resampled to the outgoing tempo (ratio from bpmFit over the two windows), fadeBars even. Mode B: no resample, fadeS seconds. The windows are first picks; mix-make --plan shows each window's fit, and mode A refuses an incoming window that isn't constant-tempo.
